import math

# Budget expenditures (in millions) from March 1942 to October 1948
expenditures = []

# 1942: March to December (10 months)
values_1942 = [3515, 3939, 4100, 4810, 5257, 5456, 5921, 6184, 6012, 6926]
expenditures.extend(values_1942)

# 1943: January to December (12 months)
values_1943 = [6728, 6358, 7746, 7300, 7475, 8260, 7499, 7831, 7667, 7619, 7947, 7744]
expenditures.extend(values_1943)

# 1944: January to December (12 months)
values_1944 = [7737, 8012, 10412, 7337, 6879, 8631, 8014, 8208, 7779, 8034, 7811, 8327]
expenditures.extend(values_1944)

# 1945: January to December (12 months)
values_1945 = [8142, 7127, 9034, 7758, 8927, 9540, 8561, 6949, 6372, 5619, 4530, 4962]
expenditures.extend(values_1945)

# 1946: January to December (12 months)
values_1946 = [4811, 3340, 3598, 3750, 3374, 4836, 3287, 2745, 2663, 2860, 2453, 3605]
expenditures.extend(values_1946)

# 1947: January to December (12 months)
values_1947 = [3019, 3731, 3239, 3407, 3284, 4996, 3553, 2962, 2673, 2394, 2113, 3176]
expenditures.extend(values_1947)

# 1948: January to October (10 months)

expenditures.extend(values_1948)

print(f"Total number of months: {len(expenditures)}")
print(f"Values: {expenditures}")

# Calculate geometric mean
# GM = (product of all values)^(1/n)
# Using log approach: exp(sum(ln(x))/n)

print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {round(geometric_mean, 2)}")
